correctness.rationale: Exact nested-ball Fourier coefficients were reconstructed for every conductor and the Haar mode. Strict ordering of increment ratios via g(s)=s coth(s), a weighted-tail argument and monotone comparison with the Haar mode proves all three sharp branches. Finite quotient eigenvalues and their multiplicities follow from character count, and the Taylor coefficients establish the sharp excess. RKHS approximation uses Fourier uniqueness and nonatomic Haar measure. The checker passed 1,222 supplementary finite assertions without being treated as proof of all-conductor claims.
